thread:
michelle: Quick follow-up from the all-hands — sharing the RCA and a compact action list for the outage earlier today. Link below. Please read and flag any clarifications you need.

michelle: RCA: https://redwood.notion.so/RCA-outage-1769002500 (summary + timeline)
michelle: Action items extracted at the bottom, owners assigned where we could. We'll run a 30m sync tomorrow to align.

ops-bot: RCA doc created by michelle — https://redwood.notion.so/RCA-outage-1769002500 · Incident ID: INC-1769 · Severity: SEV2

raj: quick q — who owns the network rule change rollback that triggered the failover? i thought infra reviewed that?

michelle: @raj, initial rollback was performed by cloud-ops (kevin) during mitigation. The RCA shows the exact rule diff and timestamp. Owner for remediation is kevin/cloud-ops.

kevin: Confirmed — I pushed the rollback. Remediation action: add automated safety gate + CI check for that rule. I'll draft the PR and tag infra. ETA Thursday.

sean: Can we get SLA hit / credit calc so support can message customers?

ops-bot: SLA impact calc (prelim): ~7.5 minutes of degraded API per region. Support prep doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk/INC-1769-sla

julia: @sean I'll work with support to craft the external blurb. Can you drop the exact window and affected endpoints into the doc?

sean: Yep — will add the endpoint list and latency graphs by EOD.

sarah: Action items I see we need to confirm: 1) Add CI check (kevin), 2) Circuit-breaker tuning (platform team, owner: raj), 3) Improve KV cache metrics to detect warmup issues (eng-runtime, owner: julia), 4) Postmortem readout for partners (michelle/support).

michelle: That's a good concise list @sarah. I'll own partner readout. Suggest we use this template for owners: short description, proposed fix, rollout plan, test plan, and PR link.

raj: For circuit-breaker tuning, quick note — current thresholds are static. I propose transient-error-based adaptive thresholds. I'll prototype and post results in #eng-runtime by Tue.

kevin: PR for rule CI check will reference the infra-runbook and include an automated rollback test. Draft PR: https://git.redwood.ai/infra/rules-ci/pulls/42

michelle: Scheduling: 30m sync tomorrow 10:30 PT. Agenda: quick read of RCA highlights, owners confirm next steps, and timeline for fixes. If you cannot make it, please update the doc with your status.

sean: Can we add a dedicated metric to detect the specific failover pattern? might help avoid manual rollback.

julia: Agree. I'll add a proposal section in the RCA doc with the metric names and dashboards (Grafana links).

ops-bot: Note: Oncall rotation for tomorrow — primary: emma, secondary: raj. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/incident-failover

kevin: ping @michelle — for the partner readout, do you want a slide deck or just a one-pager?

michelle: One-pager + 2 slides for exec summary should be enough. Please CC legal if there are quoteable metrics.

sarah: I'll track the action items in a shared checklist inside the RCA doc. Mark ones done as you complete them. :white_check_mark:

raj: noted. I'll post my prototype link in #eng-runtime when ready.

julia: Adding the KV cache metrics section now.

michelle: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround today. If anyone finds any missing timeline events, append them directly to the RCA timeline. We'll finalize the doc after tomorrow's sync.

kevin: Thanks — will update PR + doc before sync.

ops-bot: Thread closed for today. Sync reminder scheduled: 1769087100 (tomorrow 10:30 PT).
